minutes_text:
APPROVED by: Youth Commission on November 9th, 2021

  Minutes
  Alhambra Youth Commission
  October 12th, 2021

The Alhambra Youth Commission was called to order at 6:00 pm on October 12th, 2021 via
  teleconference and video conference.

Commission Members Present: Cooper, B. Gonzalez, Oliva, J. Quach, N. Quach, Webster

Commission Members Absent: Andrade, Gutierrez, Hernandez, Luc, Munson

Also present: Vincent Hon - Recreation Supervisor, Michael Macias – Director of Parks &
Recreation

IV. Follow up Regarding Social Media Status, School Board Member at Youth
Commission Meetings, Town Hall Meetings, Ethnic Training, and Voter Registration Drive
Mr. Hon introduces the new Youth Commission Member Zachary Oliva. Mr. Hon goes on to
state that the City has approved a social media account to be created, the youth commission will
need to decide on a profile name and logo design. The City has approved the creation of a
Facebook and Instagram page with the possibility of later social media platforms being used in
the future. The inclusion of a school board member to attend the meetings is currently pending
due to restrictions related to Covid-19. It has been recommended to not host a town hall meeting
for the Youth Commission as it would resemble the Youth Summit and does not have a secure
list of attendees.

V. Discussion Recapping Autumn Fest
Youth Commission President N. Quach begins the discussion by reflecting on the autumn fest
and noting that he observed many participants enjoying the variety of stations and activities
offered that drew in people of all ages. He adds that the style of organizing these city events
seems repetitive and would like to seek out options for changes to allow each event to draw in
more teen/youths and young adults.

VI. Discussion Regarding Upcoming Special Events, i.e., Pumpkin Run, Veterans Day,
Holiday Home Decorating Contest
Mr. Hon begins the discussion regarding the upcoming pumpkin run events, while it is fully
staffed and a collaboration event with another company, Mr. Hon did leave an open invitation for
the Youth Commissioners to volunteer and observe the event. Mr. Hon would like to involve the
Youth Commission in this year's holiday home decorating contest; they will be able to go around
Alhambra to view and judge the participants' homes and decide on a winner.
 VII. Discussion Regarding Youth Commission’s City Clean Up - Saturday, November 6 -
Emery Park Neighborhood
Mr. Hon states that the code enforcement will be providing the tools needed to help clean up the
neighborhood area around Emery park and is looking for volunteers who are interested in
attending. The youth commission will need to finalize a list of commissioners and any other
volunteers who wish to attend and email this list to Recreation Supervisor Hon.
VIII. Discussion Regarding Volunteer Opportunity with our Senior Center - Ideas and
Youth Summit
Mr. Hon has opened the discussion by looking for members who are interested in volunteering at
the Alhambra Senior Center, to assist and interact with the seniors in a variety of ways. He asks
the youth commission members who do wish to participate to also come up with a variety of
ways in which they can interact with the large senior population Alhambra has. The nature of
this project is quite flexible to work around the commissioner's school schedules, so after-school
hours and weekends are open. Mr. Hone would like to have a more general idea or outline of
what the youth commission has decided on by the November Youth Commission meeting. This
event would most likely be a monthly occurrence, to give time to organize different events and
available commissioners. The time frame of these events can range from 30 minutes to an hour,
to not take up too much time from the seniors and youth commissioners' schedules.

IX. Oral Communications
There are no Oral Communications at this time.

X. Commission Orals
There are no Commission Communications at this time.

XI. Adjournment
The meeting has been adjourned at 6:47 pm.
